entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon: What’s new and what’s next

media:group.media:title: Gemini 4 Argon: What’s new and what’s next
media:group.media:description:
Josh Woodward, Melvin Johnson, Sergey Brin, and Tulsee Doshi from Google DeepMind join host Logan Kilpatrick to introduce Gemini 4 Argon. Their conversation covers what made this release possible and how 100,000 Googlers tested the model before launch. They also discuss industry-leading one million output tokens, improvements to writing quality and model behavior, and the real-world breakthroughs teams are already seeing across coding, cybersecurity, and knowledge work.

media:group.media:title: Gemini 4 Argon and Google Antigravity: From 2D concept to 3D cathedral
media:group.media:description:
